annotations.title: Compare Dutch job offers after tax

description: Compares two or three Dutch job offers by what is left after income tax in 2026: base salary, 8% holiday allowance, the 30% ruling (with its salary norm), the employee pension contribution and a bonus. Returns net per year and per month for each and the difference.

bonus.description: Expected gross bonus per year in euros. Default 0.

gross_annual.description: Gross base salary per year in euros, without holiday allowance

holiday_allowance.description: 8% holiday allowance on top. Default true.

label.description: Name of the offer, e.g. the company (optional)

pension_pct.description: Employee pension contribution, % of base salary. Default 0.

name: job_offer_comparison
title: Compare Dutch job offers after tax
